root_cause.text: An inverted conditional check in `ccu_mix_trigger_fc()` causes the function to skip the frequency change trigger when the frequency change register (`common->reg_fc`) is present, and attempt to update it when it is missing.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that the condition `if (common->reg_fc)` was corrected to `if (!common->reg_fc)` in `drivers/clk/spacemit/ccu_mix.c` before executing `ccu_update()`, and the commit message notes that this inverted condition skipped the frequency change trigger and caused kernel panics during cpufreq scaling.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix the conditional check to ensure clock update occurs when the frequency change register is present.
intent_record.what: Inverted the conditional check on 'common->reg_fc' from 'if (common->reg_fc)' to 'if (!common->reg_fc)'.
intent_record.how: This ensures the function returns early when the register is not defined, allowing the update operation to proceed when the register is valid.
